claims: Super increases level by 2; Upgrade by 1; No Change leaves it unchanged.
Downgrade lowers by 1 and Break lowers by 2.
A Super result refunds some materials.
helpObservations.thresholdWordingCaveat: English help says above level 10/15; actual preview probabilities already nonzero at original grade10/15, so use measured table thresholds.

claims: Prevent Breaks reduces break probability by half.
Repair uses Metal Syrup and returns the plate to its previous level.
Repair fee grows with pre-break level.
Repair does not return the Chocosteel and Metal Syrup paid for the attempt.
helpObservations.notEstablished: Text does not expose the probability destination of prevented outcomes; redistribution to No Change comes from earlier native client-display analysis.

claims: Info row uses +2 up arrow for Super, +1 up arrow for Upgrade, dash for No Change, +1 down arrow for Downgrade, +2 down arrow for Break.
helpObservations.interpretation: Break lowers by 2, matching help and earlier native GetNextGrade derivation; this is not an actual Break outcome.

limitations: High-grade rows are navigable hypothetical detail previews while the actual selected Sword plate remains +2; Bow original plate is +0. These frames do not establish ownership of high-grade plates.
The previews show unprotected rates; no current protection toggle probability change was observed.
The preview repair quantity is a contingent post-Break repair fee, not an upfront protection payment.
Configured refund percentages are displayed; no actual current-version Super reward quantity was captured here.
No paid enhancement, Break, Repair or Super transaction occurred in these observations; server results and refund arithmetic remain unverified.
Help text and info arrows corroborate grade deltas and protection descriptions; actual redistribution into No Change relies on earlier client-code evidence.
Only Bow +0/+1 and Sword +2..+24 preview rows were visually reviewed; cross-plate equality for the remaining types is established by configuration, not per-type current UI coverage.
Directory names are operator labels only. The visible grade badges, not names, determine grade identity.
